$comment: NaN's per-model token quotas, as its docs state them. Read by `dotf doctor`
(section "NaN quota", AI-047 #1766), which sums GET /v1/usage per model over the
current period and compares it here: WARN at 80%, FAIL at 100% (NaN answers 402).
The quota is the account's, so the check watches every model listed here, every
model with usage this period, and every model harness/model-map.json binds, whoever
spends it (pi, opencode, qq/qf). Closed-world: a watched model in neither list is a
WARN, so a model NaN adds is never silently treated as unmetered.
Declared, not fetched: /v1/usage reports usage and no limits. `checked` is when the
numbers were read; doctor WARNs once it is older than 90 days. Re-read the source,
update the numbers and the date together.
Image models (flux-2-klein, qwen-image-2.1) are metered in requests, not tokens, and
are left out until something binds them.

glm5.3.note: premium tier; NaN says 'period', and adds a 400M rolling 4-hour window this check does not watch
